description: §14.8.10 (S456 round 3) — a program-body `?{CREATE VIEW … AS SELECT …}` (with `.acrossTenants()`) is not on the closed program-body allow-list. Before round 3 the compile classified what such a statement creates; the S239 r3 review executed eight shapes that created a `tenant_id` relation and compiled clean. Now any statement off the list is refused, whatever it would create.
rationale: §14.8.10 item (1) (rulings user-voice-scrml.md S456 "a, fix F7/F9 too" + "your recs, go"): in a compilation with a database, a program-body `?{}` statement SHALL be DML, a spelled `CREATE [TEMP] TABLE`, one `ALTER TABLE … ADD COLUMN`, an fts5 table with the closed option list, transaction control, `CREATE [UNIQUE] INDEX`, or a PRAGMA on the closed list; every other statement is E-SQL-PROGRAM-STATEMENT-NOT-ADMITTED.
